stem:
Gretchen made this table to show the side lengths and perimeters of three figures.

Gretchen’s Figures

| Figure   | Side Lengths (yards) | Perimeter (yards) |
|----------|----------------------|-------------------|
| Square   | 6, 6, 6, 6           | 24                |
| Triangle | 4, 7, 8              | 19                |
| Rectangle| 4, 8, 4, 8           | 32                |

What mistake, if any, did Gretchen make?

options.label: A
options.text: The perimeter of the rectangle should be 24 yards.

options.label: B
options.text: The perimeter of the square should be 36 yards.

options.label: C
options.text: The perimeter of the triangle should be 20 yards.

options.label: D
options.text: Gretchen did not make any mistakes in the table.

visual_elements: table with figures, side lengths (yards), and perimeter (yards)
difficulty_rationale: Requires addition of side lengths and verification of perimeter for multiple shapes, involving reasoning about geometric properties.
